title: Street culture and movement

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Use active poses to communicate urban energy so illustration can suggest participation without depicting motion literally.
strategic_value: Skating and street-life figures can extend Helsinki’s visual voice into youth and street culture.
demonstration: Skating figures, a seated person, a balloon seller, equipment and architectural fragments are distributed across a pale-gray field with ochre accents.
practical_value: Select poses and objects that support the activity being discussed; this still does not specify animation.
